evals.name: bakery-closed
evals.prompt: whatsapp status for my bakery: closed tomorrow (tue 10 nov) for diwali, back wed 11 nov. short
evals.expected_output: A one-glance text status: closed Tue 10 Nov for Diwali, back Wed 11 Nov.
assertions: Says closed Tue, 10 Nov for Diwali

checks.why: the message comes first, no preamble
no Markdown that WhatsApp shows literally
